packageRules.description: Development dependencies below a major: the gate decides. scripts/verify.sh builds, runs the suite, and installs the packed tarball somewhere else to use it, which is the whole of what a bump can break here.
Workflow actions below a major. These move the ground the release stands on, so they wait out the same soak.

Majors are read by a person. Two of the three still open when this was written are majors that pass npm install and then break something the version number does not mention: TypeScript 7 stops resolving @types/node, and @ffmpeg/core 0.12 moves the files a skipIf tests for, so the suite goes green with the test no longer running.
